name: hud_ui_options_panel_sound_active_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_SoundActive::InitFromOptions checks the sound-active toggle when the mute-sound option is disabled.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. Current Binary Ninja HLIL renders the zero comparison through neg/sbb arithmetic, but the source behavior is verified against the current decompilation.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cb90 calls zOpt::GetMuteSoundOption and passes the inverted zero/nonzero mute state to HudUiCheckToggleWidget::SetChecked.
Native smoke zhud_options_panel_sound_active_init_from_options_smoke installs the mute option pointer and verifies mute value 0 sets the sound-active toggle while mute value 1 clears it.
